notes.desc: Raider fortress blast gate spanning the road (boss spawn). Road along +Z, origin road centre, gate front faces -Z (toward the player), depth z 0..8. Road clear width 14 (x +-7), clearance 11 m to the portcullis spikes. Two 26 m towers with scrap plating, braziers, searchlights, skulls; lintel gatehouse with big horned skull emblem; banners.
notes.spawn: sockets spawn_center (0,0,6), spawn_L (-3.5,0,6), spawn_R (3.5,0,6): boss/escort spawn points inside the gate; flame_* = brazier fire positions, light_* = searchlight positions
